combat.weaponWheel: Redesigned — R1/RB to switch between weapons and items

healing.name: Zombix
healing.effect: Health restoration, diminishing effectiveness from overuse

combat.weaponRetrieval: Weapons never permanently lost — retrieve from Ammu-Nation locker or personal vehicle
combat.stealth: Openly carrying long guns makes NPCs nervous and draws police attention
combat.slowMotion: Dead Eye-style slow-motion aiming ability confirmed
combat.nonLethal: Suppressive fire — intentionally firing near targets to intimidate without killing

vehicles.purchasing: Vehicles can be bought at dealerships and showrooms
vehicles.storage: Limited weapon storage in vehicles (trunk, capacity shown as X/4)
vehicles.customization: Deep customization across multiple in-game shops
vehicles.payAndSpray: Returns for repainting, repairing, valuing, and re-registering stolen vehicles
vehicles.garages: Purchasable garage properties with weapon locker and stolen-goods deposit
vehicles.personalStorage: Personal and stolen vehicles double as mobile weapon storage (like RDR2 horse)

world.npcReactions: NPCs react to everything the player does, including audibly to brandished weapons
world.itemPickup: Players can pick up items NPCs are carrying — melee weapons, trash, hats
world.sprinting: Mapped to left stick (L3) rather than button-mashing
